Subject: POC metrics + trial plan — VeldTech evaluation (next steps)

Hi Oliver — great conversation earlier. This thread is a short post-call recap and a proposed trial/runbook so we can get aligned quickly. TL;DR: 3-week evaluation, two checkpoints, success metrics below, owners and a couple of asks from your side.

Scope summary
- Goal: Validate inference performance and integration for VeldChat (customer support agent) using your sample workload and three representative prompts.
- Environment: Redwood Dedicated (staging pool) + small ingress load from VeldTech test clients.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): test account provisioning, access + sample data exchange.
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests (connect API, run 10k sample inferences).
- Week 2: stability and throughput ramp (concurrency tests, KV/cache warmups).
- Week 3: acceptance window + readout.

Acceptance criteria (draft) — please review and flag changes
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 350 ms for a 512-token prompt (measured over a 1-hour window at test QPS).
- Throughput: sustain 20 concurrent QPS with <2% error rate (inference errors/timeouts).
- Cost: average cost/token <= $0.002 (model + infra blended) during acceptance window.
- Quality: on canonical prompt set (n=120), agent answer accuracy >= 86% (weighted scoring: intent-match 70%, factual correctness 30%).
- Reliability: system should not exceed 2x baseline memory usage and must not evict KV cache mid-run under normal load.

Owners / responsibilities
- Redwood: Kimberly (technical lead, integration, SLO measurement), Rishi (commercial/questions, contract contact).
- VeldTech: Oliver (product), procurement@veldttech.com (procurement). Monica (CS) will run the trial configuration and coordinate instrumentation.

Immediate asks for VeldTech
1) Confirm the three canonical prompts + one fallback prompt by EOD Thursday so we can bake them into the suite.
2) Confirm data retention requirement (how long logs & KV cache snapshots must be stored).
3) Provide an account for test clients (or we can spin synthetic traffic).

Attachments: veldt_trial_config.yaml (draft runtime + sampling config), mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (kickoff tasks).

If that looks good I'll: (a) upload the final config to the Drive link, (b) provision a staging endpoint, and (c) schedule the kickoff call.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Oliver / procurement team — thanks for the quick review and the asks. Responses inline below and I've attached a short SOC2 evidence summary as requested.

- Data retention: Redwood Dedicated can retain logs for up to 18 months in the staging tenancy; we'll surface them via a read-only S3 export to your bucket. If you prefer, we can also configure a 12-month TTL to match your policy.

- SOC2 evidence: attaching soc2-evidence-summary.pdf (control mappings, last audit date, point of contact). Full bundle available under NDA; we can start with the one-pager.

- Weighted scoring: quick example: for each canonical prompt, we score intent-match (0–1) and factual correctness (0–1). Final prompt score = 0.7 * intent + 0.3 * factual. The acceptance threshold (86%) is the average across the canonical set. I'll upload a one-page worksheet (Drive) showing sample grading.

- Cost target: after internal review, Redwood proposes a blended cost/token target of <= $0.0025 during the acceptance window (we can split visibility of model vs infra costs in the dashboard). We left $0.002 in the original draft to be aggressive — if VeldTech prefers $0.0020 we can discuss tradeoffs (smaller batch sizes vs latency).

Updated next steps (I will take action items marked A):
A1) Kimberly: finalize canonical prompt set and upload to Drive (by EOD Thu).
A2) Monica: deploy the trial config + provisioning (target Fri).
A3) Rishi: prepare the Mutual Action Plan with milestones & procurement-friendly dates (will add to the XLS and share a DocuSign link).
A4) Oliver / procurement: confirm retention TTL (12 vs 18 months) and return procurement contact for DocuSign routing.

Attachments: soc2-evidence-summary.pdf, updated mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft with milestones).

Let me know if you'd like a quick 20-min kickoff tomorrow morning.

Best,
Kimberly
